opennyai_summary.arguments:
As the alleged victim was found to be major on the date of incident, so the charge-sheet against the applicant was not filed under POCSO Act.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 06.05.2022, hence, prayer for bail is made.
opennyai_summary.final__facts:
Learned A.G.A., however, opposed the prayer of bail.
In her statement before the doctor, the victim had stated that she was in talking terms with the applicant.
Both the first informant and the victim have denied committal of any rape with the victim in the trial court.
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
From the perusal of the record, it is found that in the FIR the victim is shown to be minor but during investigation the investigating officer did not find the victim to be minor and, thus, the charge-sheet was not filed under POCSO Act.
In the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. also, the victim did not name the applicant.
Though, in the statements under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. of the victim and the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. of the first informant the allegation of committal of rape is there but in the statements before the trial court the first informant as PW-1 and the victim as PW-2 have not supported the prosecution version.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
The second bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant Alishan, who is involved in aforesaid crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
1. The applicant will attend and co-operate the trial proceedings pending before the court concerned on the dates fixed after release.
2. The applicant will not tamper with the witnesses.
3. The applicant will not indulge in any illegal activities during the bail period.
The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by the court concerned and in case of breach of any of the above conditions, the trial court shall be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.
It is clarified that the observations, if any, made in this order are strictly confined to the disposal of this bail application and must not be construed to have any reflection on the ultimate merits of the case.
